title: Tight Pants
wikitext: {{Infobox mousehat |name = Tight Pants |image = Tight Pants.png |source = Desert Festival }} The '''Tight Pants''' is a pants item that can be obtained from [[Desert Festival#Emily's Outfit Services|Emily's outfit services]] at the [[Desert Festival]]. Male players have a ≈6.38% chance to receive an outfit with Tight Pants, while female players have a ≈4.17% chance. It is one of only two pants items that cannot be [[Tailoring#Pants|tailored]].
